questions.why: *every day* — регулярність, маркер Present Simple, як і *I go*. Інші варіанти — маркери Present Continuous.

questions.q: Which marker goes with Present Continuous?
questions.why: *at the moment* — «саме зараз», маркер Present Continuous. *usually, never, every week* — маркери Present Simple.
Прислівник частоти стоїть після *to be*: *She is always late.*

questions.q: Choose: 'I ___ eat meat.' (0% — I am a vegetarian)
questions.why: Вегетаріанець ніколи не їсть м'яса — *never*.
*Look!* — зараз, Present Continuous: *It is snowing.*

options: He goes usually to school by bus.
He usually goes to school by bus.
He goes to usually school by bus.
Usually goes he to school by bus.
questions.why: Прислівник частоти — перед основним дієсловом: *He usually goes…*

questions.q: 'Twice a week' is a marker of:
questions.why: *twice a week* — регулярність, Present Simple.

questions.q: 'He is always complaining!' — Present Continuous with always expresses:
questions.why: *always* + Present Continuous — роздратування повторюваною дією.
*these days* — тимчасова ситуація, підходить до Present Continuous.
*ago* («тому») — маркер Past Simple: *two years ago*.
*ever* («колись») — маркер Present Perfect у питаннях. *never* теж граматично можливе (*Have you never been…?* — здивування).
*yet* («ще», у запереченні) — маркер Present Perfect, стоїть у кінці.
*at the moment* — сталий вираз.
*next week* — без прийменника.
*last year* — Past Simple: *went*.
*already* — Present Perfect: *I have seen this film already.*
*right now* — Present Continuous: *is having a shower*.
Конкретний момент у минулому (*At 7 pm yesterday*) — Past Continuous.
*since Monday* — від моменту до тепер, Present Perfect: *haven't seen*.
*yesterday* — Past Simple: *saw*.
*already* — Present Perfect: *has already left*.
*now* — Present Continuous.
*How long* про дію, що почалася в минулому й триває досі, — Present Perfect Continuous: *How long have you been working…?*

questions.q: By the end of the year we ___ the project.
questions.why: *By the end of the year* — до моменту в майбутньому, Future Perfect: *will have finished*.

questions.q: This time tomorrow we ___ (fly) over the Atlantic.
questions.why: *This time tomorrow* — процес у майбутньому, Future Continuous: *will be flying*.
